limitations: The execution profile id stays omp-18.4.12-host-tools-v2 for 18.11.3 offerings, as Codex 0.163.0 kept the 0.162.0 profile id.

OMP 18.11.3 replays opaque reasoning on session restore (18.4.12 dropped it). Production shares the assignment budget root across attempts, so the gateway recognises it; the host suite now does the same.

Earlier failed attempts are kept as findings: the first 18.11.3 host run (before the shared budget root) failed its restore turn with input_budget/unknown_reasoning; the first supervisor runs (both versions) stopped at startup because the output path was too long for the tmux socket.

The first scripted workflow attempt failed in the native picker: verify-native-workflow.ts passes an offering key without the FOR-42 billing-route suffix. live_tests.rs now resolves it to the single route.
The live launch used one provider and model (zai glm-4.7, anthropic-messages, low effort). Other OMP providers and APIs on 18.11.3 are covered only by the synthetic suites.
The binaries for the live launch were built from the working tree before the admission commit was created; the commit records exactly that tree.
